title: Code and data for: Oxidation and temperature limits of sharp ZrB2-SiC nose tips in hypersonic flight
description: Low-order coupled thermal and oxidation model of sharp ZrB2-SiC nose tips in hypersonic flight, with saved run outputs, validation reports and figure scripts. The furnace, arc-jet and plasmatron validation checks fail their criteria. With the fully catalytic bound the model is a conservative screening tool for surface temperature under ground-test conditions, untested for flight.
